title: Compliance records sit in the asset card's Compliance section
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. An asset (e.g. unit 402 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia of "Aacrest Works") enrolled on a schedule that has a compliance service "CVIP" (Term 12 months), seeded with the standard steps.
  3. Open the asset page; the asset card is on the left and its Compliance section sits below Contact.
custom_steps:
1. In the Compliance section click + Add record; fill Type CVIP, Term 12 months, Start date 14 Oct 2025, Certificate number AB-4471902; Save. Read the line that appears.
  2. Click the line; then close the form.
  3. Start Enroll in Schedule on another asset, pick the same schedule and click + Add record on the CVIP row; compare the form.
  4. Read the controls beside the existing record's line.
  5. Remove the asset from its schedule (Maintenance tab > schedule menu > Remove from schedule) and look at the Compliance section again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The section shows "CVIP · AB-4471902 · ends 14 Oct 2026" (14 Oct 2025 + 12 months) with + Add record beneath.
  • The line opens the record form.
  • The enrolment modal's record row opens the same record form.
  • The existing record shows Edit, and + Add record stays beside it for a renewal.
  • The Compliance section still shows the record when the asset is on no schedule.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10565 (S8, Compliance inspection records on the asset), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S8 (Where records are reached; S8-R5, S8-R7, S8-R13); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
